data.title: 陈千语 · 荒原星空下的机车并肩
data.description: 在塔卫二寂静无垠的高原绝壁边，重型全地形机车的车灯照亮了脚下嶙峋的岩石。千语脱下防风外套披在对方肩上，两人并排坐在宽阔的车座上仰望浩瀚的异星双月。冷冽的夜风被彼此的体温阻隔，千语转过脸，目光中盛满了无声的守护。
data.location: alien plateau cliff under twin moons
data.action: sitting together on motorcycle, sharing jacket, looking at alien moons
data.lighting: 异星荒原断崖双月银白月华与机车前大灯锐芒
data.promptProse: Perched together on a heavy all-terrain motorcycle atop a windswept plateau cliff, Chen Qianyu shares her windbreaker jacket under glowing alien twin moons. The vast cosmic sky blankets the wasteland as she gazes with quiet, protective warmth.
data.animaCaption: Twin alien moons and the bright beam of her motorcycle lamp illuminate the desolate plateau as Qianyu gazes up at the cosmos.
